name: TanStack Query data acquisition
summary: Design server-state queries, caching, invalidation, mutations, and optimistic updates.
description: Use when implementing or reviewing frontend server-state flows: typed queries, request caching, invalidation, mutations, optimistic updates, infinite queries, prefetch, SSR hydration, or API-layer integration. Do not use for local UI state or Service Worker caching; Chinese triggers include data fetch, cache, optimistic updates.

boundaryWorkflows: Use a form workflow for form state, validation, and submit UI.
Use a PWA workflow for Service Worker and offline cache policy.
Use a virtualization workflow for DOM rendering performance in infinite lists.
